block_a_inventory_auth.name: RoktRazo BD Inventory — 4x/day (6h interval) Asia/Shanghai
block_a_inventory_auth.root_cause_detail: Before the failed firing there was an 18.2h scheduling gap (planned_at 2026-10-24T14:43:48, actual trigger 2026-10-25T02:57:10, gap 65601.7s, skipped_slots 2). No boot, shutdown, or sleep/wake events exist in that window and AC standby timeout is 0 (never sleep), so the gap is attributable to the WorkBuddy desktop app not running, not to power management. The catch-up firing then failed fail-closed with automation-auth-unavailable before any session context existed.
block_a_inventory_auth.reauth_rationale: owner_status is confirmed and the owner id equals the active user profile; three consecutive production firings succeeded after the transient without any reauthorization.
block_a_inventory_auth.note_automations_last_run_at: automations.last_run_at (2026-08-23) is stale and must not be used; automation_runtime_state.last_run_at is authoritative.

endpoint_semantics.note: Read operations are POST /v1/{...}, not GET. GET returns HTTP 404 with an explicit contract note. An earlier handoff read them as GET and reported spurious 404s.

readonly_ops_failed.note: requires an explicit operation id; not a health signal

block_b_bridge_8791.survival_evidence: supervisor.jsonl shows STALE_LOCK_RECLAIMED + SUPERVISOR_START + SPAWN and then no HEALTH_TRANSITION; afterwards the port shows only TIME_WAIT client entries and no LISTENING row.
blocked_launch_paths: explorer.exe dispatch of start_supervisor.cmd -> rc=1, no SUPERVISOR_START emitted

block_c_production_collection.partial_rationale: status=partial with stop_reason=safe_inventory_gap and no SAFE gain is the documented normal outcome when the pool already exceeds target minus the bounded discovery budget.

provider_results.proxy_note: These requests are timestamped after the SCRAPER_PROXY migration to 127.0.0.1:7877, so they are positive evidence that the migrated proxy carried real production traffic.

target_projection.note: 2026-10-26 is a Monday (weekday) so target drops to 50. SAFE=56 already exceeds 50, therefore the next firing is expected to short-circuit as target_met with zero provider requests. That is designed behavior, not a collection failure, and must not be reported as SAFE regression.

scheduler_reconciliation.classification_note: A firing with no job_runs row is classified firings_without_production_run, not automatically a missed firing; the agent layer may refuse fail-closed by design.

scope_b_exclude_mx_proxy.reason_not_modified: Out of this task's authorized scope; MX resolution currently survives via the documented DNS fallback.
scope_b_exclude_mx_proxy.recommended_followup: Migrate to 127.0.0.1:7877 under explicit owner approval, then verify query_mx() positive and negative controls.

open_blockers.detail: The only working scheduler is the WorkBuddy automation layer, which requires the desktop app to be running with a logged-in user. The intended login-free scheduler (Windows service BDExecutionHost) is a zombie registration: pythonservice.exe is missing at the configured path and bd_execution_host_service.py is retired under _retired/p3d_20260909/.

Bridge starts and passes health in-turn but cannot outlive an agent call because the host job object forbids breakaway. HKCU Run already holds the correct launch command, so a single logoff/logon makes it persistent without admin.
